learning_outcomes.text: Familiarity with techniques for presenting ideas and concepts in a positive and convincing way.
Knowledge about the way of thinking of people from other engineering disciplines.
Knowledge of the requirements necessary for implementing skills.

assessment_rules: To pass "Lectures and Seminars I", students must pass the corresponding Local Master's degree course in Mechatronic Engineering. The evaluation rules for that course will be provided by the professors at the beginning of the academic year. The grade obtained in "Lectures and Seminars I" will be exactly the same as that obtained in "Introduction to Mechatronic Systems".
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica (EPI Gijón)
degree: Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica
